articulation.label: coin
articulation.alt: coin: /k/ → /ɔɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/ɔ/: Start with a back vowel and rounded lips.
/ɪ/: Glide forward and up; relax lip rounding.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: join
articulation.alt: join: /dʒ/ → /ɔɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /dʒ/: Brief closure and release, with voice.
/ɔ/: Start with a back vowel and rounded lips.
/ɪ/: Glide forward and up; relax lip rounding.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: toy
articulation.alt: toy: /t/ → /ɔɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɔ/: Start with a back vowel and rounded lips.
/ɪ/: Glide forward and up; relax lip rounding.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: boy
articulation.alt: boy: /b/ → /ɔɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ɔ/: Start with a back vowel and rounded lips.
/ɪ/: Glide forward and up; relax lip rounding.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
